description: The same D3 CRITICAL decision delivered to Meridian's SIEM as a Splunk HEC event (POST to /services/collector/event). The minimized record lives under "event"; index/sourcetype/time are HEC routing metadata, not telemetry. This mirrors server/data-plane/siem/mapping.go renderSplunk. Sentinel (DCR rows) and Elastic (ECS bulk) connectors carry the identical minimized record in their own envelopes.

connector.auth: Splunk <HEC token> (carried in the Authorization header, never logged)

notes: The body under "event" is byte-identical in content to egress/webhook-body.json - one decision, two transports. The egress client is the SSRF-hardened safehttp client, and the connector secret (HEC token) is held server-side and never appears in telemetry. On the wire multiple events are newline-delimited (HEC batch) and gzip-compressed.
